answer: Resist sybils by binding each agent identity to one distinct human principal who re-confirms with a signed message every few epochs, like a grove where each tree has one root. One principal can sponsor only one agent, so a farmer needs a thousand real humans, not a thousand copied keys. An opal-bright public registry lists every linkage, and an ocean of fake identities collapses into the few principals behind them, who lose their own standing if their agents cheat.
